issue.title: Mark parameters of `Mockito.when` @Nullable
issue.body: I have a nullable method: That I want to mock. The problem is that IDEA shows tons of warnings because `Mockito.when` parameter is not marked as `@Nullable`: **I suggest to add [JSpecify](https://jspecify.dev/docs/user-guide/) to Mockito dependencies, and mark (at least) parameters of `Mockito.when` as `@Nullable`.**
